askBeforeChanges.title: Ask before Claude changes Social Champ
askBeforeChanges.description: Off by default: Claude creates, edits and schedules posts from the chat straight away, with no batch limit. Turn on to be shown each change first (batches over 10 then go to the pane). Deletes and metrics are refused either way
